# CUNYAutoLogin

> CUNYAutoLogin is a free, open-source browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) that automatically fills and submits your CUNY Login — email, password, and six-digit 2FA code — on CUNY's official sign-in page. Credentials are encrypted on your device with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM; there is no server, no account, no cloud sync, and no analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/): What it does, how it works, and why it's safe
- [Why CUNY logs you out](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/why-does-cuny-log-you-out/): Why CUNY's single sign-on signs you out so often (short-lived SSO session, per-service sessions, repeated 2FA), and how to stop re-typing your password and authenticator code
- [Install](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/install/): Install on Chrome, Edge, or Firefox from the official stores
- [Security](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/security/): How credentials are encrypted and stored, verified claim by claim against the source
- [FAQ](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/faq/): Security, 2FA, mobile support, cloud sync, and troubleshooting
- [Privacy Policy](https://cunyautologin.alexmarty.dev/privacy/): Exactly what is stored, where, and how it is protected
